activeSlice.scope: Improve Hunter V2 shadow recommendation quality without changing rollout gates: anchor retrieval queries to the Brand identity, feed deterministic Brand-name evidence fit into pre-ranking and common quality, and make certified final EEI selection refill after topic-diversity pruning while enforcing the actual <=20% exploration share.
successCriteria: Every operational shadow lexical/semantic retrieval query includes the Brand identity without changing intent IDs or the two-intent paid-search budget.
Brand-specific evidence subjects receive deterministic Brand identity fit; generic subjects do not receive synthetic relevance credit.
V2 common quality uses deterministic Brand identity fit instead of treating every parent-topic-labelled result as fully Brand-relevant.
Certified EEI finalization refills from eligible alternatives after topic-share pruning when possible, preserving up to six useful recommendations.
The actual final exploration share never exceeds 0.20, including when fewer than six recommendations survive.
No quality-delta, exploration, topic-share, retrieval, failure, latency or cost rollout threshold changes.
R5R11 pacing remains intact; Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
The same 3x3 pre-gate must pass all non-sample-size gates on the exact merge SHA before any 30-pair gate.

priorPreGateEvidence.reason: Model pressure/429s were cleared. Remaining blockers were V2 quality regression and a 25% exploration share caused by a four-item final list. Evidence also showed generic Python searches that omitted the Brand identity.
